report.summary: Patient P-D009 (Eileen Costigan, 73F) screened positive for a transportation need and has a kept cardiology appointment (appt:1) on 2026-10-19 at 10:30 AM at the hospital cardiology clinic. She has Medicare Advantage (Lakeshore Senior PPO) with transport benefit listed as unknown; no facility location is on file so transit feasibility could not be computed. Her home tract (17031720500) has 26 transit stops within 800m and early-morning service, with 4.5% of residents reporting lack of transportation (CDC PLACES). Kidney Care Rides eligibility was verified via the partner API: eligible. Senior Shuttle West is age-appropriate (60+, free weekday medical rides). Medicaid Ride Line likely does not apply (Medicare Advantage, not Medicaid) unless she is dual-eligible. ADA paratransit is an option with up to 21-day certification.
